description: An indoor classroom in oil-paint style, with sunlight through tall windows. A woman with glasses sits in the middle with her hand to her chin, watching. A blond boy plays a violin at left, a boy in a dark shirt and a boy in a patterned shirt work on a tall tower of wooden blocks, a boy in a green shirt reads an open picture book, and a girl in a skirt dances with her arms raised at right. Posters, bookshelves and children's drawings line the walls. No legible text, no frame.
